full_judgment: "We hold that the regularization of other 99 persons has a presumption of correctness and respondents do not say that it was done illegally. From the reply to affidavit-in-opposition, it appears that the respondents have already kept 98 posts of Assistant Engineers vacant and therefore in fitness of things they should consider the present cases in the same way as has been done in the cases of 99 Assistant Engineers as in Annexures-F and F-1 to the writ petition in accordance with law.
